# Viktor through an OpenAI-compatible or Anthropic-compatible base URL

Any framework or app with a base-URL setting can use Viktor as a model with no extra package:

| Wire | Base URL | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| OpenAI Chat Completions and Responses | `https://api.viktor.com/api/compat/v1` | model id `viktor` |
| Anthropic Messages | `https://api.viktor.com/api/compat` | clients append `/v1/messages`; model id `viktor` |

Rules that apply to every recipe: use a long timeout (a Viktor turn can run for up to 600 s while it works in its
own tools), turn automatic retries off (a failed Viktor run was billed and may have acted), pass tool-call ids back
unchanged (they are routing tokens), and expect system prompts to be added to Viktor's own instructions.
These recipes do not add Viktor's typed errors or empty-reply detection; the native adapter packages do.

### Google ADK (Python, via LiteLLM)

```python
from google.adk.agents import Agent
from google.adk.models.lite_llm import LiteLlm

agent = Agent(name="assistant", model=LiteLlm(
    model="openai/viktor", api_base="https://api.viktor.com/api/compat/v1", api_key=os.environ["VIKTOR_API_KEY"]))
```

### OpenAI SDK (Python)

```python
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(base_url="https://api.viktor.com/api/compat/v1", api_key=os.environ["VIKTOR_API_KEY"], timeout=660, max_retries=0)
print(client.chat.completions.create(model="viktor", messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "hello"}]).choices[0].message.content)
```

### Anthropic SDK and Claude Agent SDK (Anthropic-compatible wire)

```bash
export ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=https://api.viktor.com/api/compat
export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=$VIKTOR_API_KEY
export ANTHROPIC_MODEL=viktor ANTHROPIC_SMALL_FAST_MODEL=viktor
```
